Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen MIRON fitness product UI mockup, NOT a collage, no browser/device frame, no explanation outside the app. Russian UI, clean readable Manrope-like text, consistent thin stroke icons and geometric spaced MIRON wordmark exactly like reference. Friendly premium soft animated-film 3D art, no comic outlines, no lime double slashes. Calm practical adult fitness companion. Content must be comfortably readable at actual app scale. Only one selected companion per screen, no theme/companion switches, no personality tags, no nested cards. Anatomy: every depicted human has exactly TWO arms/two hands/two legs, no duplicated limbs or faces. Keep hands simple and separated, ideally show portrait avatars rather than a large full-body person in dense task views. Respect safe areas and large 48px touch targets. All numbers are illustrative mock data.
Visual system: charcoal #171a1e canvas, #24282e surfaces, warm white main text, muted slate secondary text, coral #ff977f primary buttons with dark text, coral account XP bar. Thin quiet borders, modest 14px corners, no glass, neon or excessive gradients. Match supplied dark dashboard typography and component scale.
Landscape desktop screen, 1920x1200. WORKOUT PLAN REVIEW before starting. Sidebar MIRON, Сегодня, Тренировки selected, Календарь, Прогресс, bottom Профиль. Main page title 'Всё тело · зал'; subtitle 'Около 40 мин · 5 упражнений'. Small account progress top right 'Уровень 1 · 100 / 500 XP'. Main wide left area: clean ordered workout list with small attractive soft-3D EQUIPMENT thumbnails (no human doing exercises): 'Разминка', then 1 'Жим гантелей лёжа' '3 × 10', 2 'Тяга горизонтального блока' '3 × 12', 3 'Жим ногами' '3 × 12', 4 'Ягодичный мост' '3 × 12', 5 'Планка' '3 × 30 сек'. Each row has a quiet 'Заменить' action, a grip to reorder and expansion chevron; show counts clearly. Small note 'План можно отредактировать до старта'. Bottom main coral button 'Начать тренировку' and secondary 'Сохранить шаблон'. Right separate companion workspace with an expressive modest waist-up Max, black M shirt, ONLY TWO ARMS, both hands relaxed visible by his sides (no hand at head), warm gym background inside his own area. Below his portrait a concise chat 'Макс' message 'Вот план на сегодня. Если что-то не подходит — заменим.' Input 'Спроси о плане…', microphone and send. Make the plan the hero, character no more than 25% screen area. No huge empty gaps, no crowded tiny text.
